capture_boundary.meaning: Capture happens inside Send before any call into the wrapped transport; the controller is installed as Config.Transport so every Node.emit funnel passes through it, and captured messages never continue automatically along the underlying send path.

pending_store.meaning: map[uint64]pendingEntry guarded by a mutex; each entry holds a deep-cloned Message snapshot plus its capture order.

entrypoint.meaning: Test-mode Transport seam: Send clones the outbound message, assigns a CaptureSequence, stores it in the pending store, and suppresses the original send before it can reach the wrapped environment transport.

message_capture.copy_strategy: Deep clone via Message.Clone() before storage (entries and entry payloads copied); ListPending returns independent value snapshots of ID/From/To/Type/CaptureSequence ordered by CaptureSequence.
message_capture.production_mode: Nodes use the raw environment Transport directly; the MessageController is not installed, so no capture or suppression occurs.
message_capture.test_mode: Nodes install the MessageController as their Config.Transport; Send captures a stable snapshot of every outbound protocol message and suppresses the underlying send (returns nil without calling the wrapped transport).
notes: Added an additive seam in new file message_control.go; no protocol logic in node.go or transport.go was modified.
NewMessageController(Transport), ListPending() with ID/From/To/Type/CaptureSequence, and ClearPending() implement the spec's thin external testing contract.
Every outbound message funnels through Node.emit (node.go:332) into the node's Transport; with the controller installed, capture precedes any delivery and no scheduling policy is implemented.
Verified by new tests in message_control_test.go: two vote requests captured after the first campaign, zero messages delivered to the underlying transport, and ClearPending empties the store.

capture_boundary.meaning: Injected messages re-enter the protocol through Node.Step (node.go:134), the normal protocol input boundary, which verifies message.To == node.id and processes message.Clone() so content is never mutated.

pending_store.meaning: Same per-instance pending store as capture; Inject looks up by ID and deletes the entry only on nil delivery error.

entrypoint.meaning: Selects a pending message by message ID and delivers it through the recorded target's normal protocol input boundary; consumes the message only after delivery succeeds.

message_injection.copy_strategy: The stored snapshot is deep-cloned before delivery; the delivered message content is unchanged (Step also clones before processing), and the caller's message is never mutated.
message_injection.production_mode: Controller not installed; message flow follows the raw transport path without injection.
message_injection.test_mode: Inject(messageID) delivers via the wrapped transport (MemoryTransport.Send routes by message.To to the recorded target's Step); successful delivery consumes exactly that message, while delivery errors (e.g. ErrPaused, ErrUnknownNode) preserve it in PENDING state.
notes: Inject and ClearPending are serialized through a single operation mutex (opMu); outbound capture (Send) may still occur concurrently, and no IN_FLIGHT state was added for concurrent Inject calls.
Unknown message IDs return ErrUnknownMessage; failed injections leave the message pending, satisfying consume-on-success/keep-on-failure semantics.

Verified by new tests in message_control_test.go: injection of captured vote requests drives node 1 to leader through Step, successful injection consumes the message, failed injection (paused target) keeps it pending, and unknown IDs error.
